title: Fixed Nested Helical Chutes and Twin Outlet Seed Separator
description: One newly authored complete fixed dry seed-spiral-separator-inspired apparatus. A four-foot low crossed base carries a full tall central mast. Two independent whole continuous nested helical troughs descend twice around the mast: one wide inner shallow flight with a low escape-side lip and one narrower outer collector with a higher outside wall. Each complete thick open material trough continues without a break into its own low straight tangential discharge, so there are two distinct lower open outlets rather than a single elevated conveyor inlet and exit. Eight entire low radial supports and eight short outer-wall posts connect the outer collector back to the mast, and two full low legs carry the discharge ends. One complete open tapered receiving hopper with a genuine hollow lower throat feeds the top inner flight; whole support brackets and a small fixed side flow-gate exterior complete the apparatus. The open paired channels and full central load path are original numeric geometry, not imported helical conveyor, tilted screw classifier, bowl feeder, slide or sample-divider parts. Unlike the existing single full-width deck with peripheral columns and open central cylinder, both new nested channels are jointly arranged around one supporting central mast and terminate in separate low outlets. Unlike a shaft-mounted screw in a trough there is no rotating ribbon, inclined basin or end-bearing chassis; unlike the sample divider there are no alternating straight channels or two detached receiver pans. One complete prop zero scenes, metres native Z up, four opaque PBR materials. No seeds, motor, animation, rigging or interaction.
